name: Seasons
description: Serene Seasons turns the Overworld year into four seasons: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter.

pages.title: Seasons
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Crops only grow in the right season; winter is hardest
- A season is 24 days and a year 96
- A glass roof or a farm deep underground gets around it
- A **Calendar** shows the season and day

Serene Seasons turns the Overworld year into four seasons: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter. Each splits into Early, Mid and Late.\
\
Every sub-season lasts 8 days, so a season is 24 days and a year 96. Foliage colors follow the season.

pages.title: Calendar
pages.text: Its tooltip shows the current season and day. Crafted from a Clock and paper. Handy for planning plantings.

pages.title: Weather
pages.text: Winter brings snow and ice: lakes and rivers in cold places can freeze over. Oceans stay open all year (only frozen oceans freeze), so boats can always get out to sea. Rain, snow and storm frequency vary with the season. Tropical biomes (deserts, badlands, savanna, jungle and similar) have Wet and Dry seasons instead.

pages.title: Crops
pages.text:
**The big rule:** crops only grow in the right season. Out of season they grow slowly. A [#](7A3C9A)[config](entry://glossary/config)[#]() setting can make them stop or break instead. Tooltips may list a crop's seasons.\
\
Winter is hardest: very few crops grow. [#](2E5AAC)[Details](entry://survival/seasons_crops)[#]().

pages.title: Greenhouses
pages.text:
Two ways around it:
- Plants under a glass roof count as in season, using the greenhouse glass [#](7A3C9A)[tag](entry://glossary/tags)[#]() (ordinary glass blocks).
- Crops deep underground are also fertile, below a height set in the config.

pages.title: Season Sensor
pages.text: Emits a redstone signal depending on the season, like a Daylight Detector. Lets machines react to the time of year.

pages.title: Seasonal Integration
pages.text: [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Seasonal Integration is a [#](7A3C9A)[datapack](entry://glossary/datapack)[#]() that teaches Serene Seasons about other mods: it adds crops to the season lists and sorts biomes into tropical or off-limits.
